A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same HarDBench study and complete 47-page documents, including Appendices A and B. Full-text and rendered-page comparisons establish identical content except for the first-page arXiv version/date stamp and its presentation.

before.justification: v2 reports original LLM vulnerability evaluations, SUBA alignment experiments, robustness analyses, and human validation results in Section 5 and Appendix A.

after.justification: v3 retains the same original experimental and human-validation results, including the main evaluations and appendix analyses.

M1.justification: The draft-generation pipeline, co-authoring prompts, preference labeling, and SUBA procedures using KTO and GRPO are identical, including Appendix A.5's reward formulation.

E1.justification: Both retain the same four harmful domains, eight benign domains, four long-form utility benchmarks, and paraphrased-query evaluation. Appendix B's keyword coverage is identical.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged, including Zero-shot, Safety Prompt, and the corresponding SUBA data variants in Tables 4 and 9. The other reported comparisons also retain identical participants.

E3.justification: The balanced 400-draft test set, model configurations, training budgets, HS/ASR/RAR metrics, utility scoring, and human-evaluation procedures are unchanged in the main text and Appendix A.

E4.justification: Both retain identical task-framing and training-data ablations, paraphrase robustness tests, evaluator validation, domain analyses, and case studies.

E5.justification: Fixed-seed information and statistical reporting are identical. Human agreement, inter-annotator agreement, and evaluator correlations retain the same reporting practices in Tables 5, 8, 11, and 12.

E6.justification: All numerical results, plotted findings, and qualitative examples are identical. For example, Table 1 reports GPT-4o CoJP HS 4.87 and ASR 96.75% in both versions; appendix results are likewise unchanged.

T1.justification: Mathematical definitions and formulas are identical throughout both PDFs. No assumptions, derivations, proofs, or mathematical corrections are added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain identical claims about co-authoring vulnerabilities, HarDBench, and SUBA's safety-utility balance.

C2.justification: Section 6, Limitations, and appendix discussions retain the same explanations of task framing, benign-data balance, generalization, actionable specificity, and applicability boundaries.

D1.justification: Hardware, hyperparameters, LoRA configurations, prompt templates, project link, and data-access policy are unchanged. The updated arXiv version link does not change code or data access information.

R1.justification: Related-work discussions, cited works, references, and positioning relative to prior jailbreak and alignment research are identical.

P1.justification: Only the first-page arXiv stamp text changes from v2 dated 9 Jun 2026 to v3 dated 13 Jul 2026. Paper wording, headings, and document structure are otherwise identical.

P2.justification: The first-page vertical arXiv stamp changes placement and formatting. All figures, tables, captions, and remaining layout are unchanged; rendered pages 2-47 are pixel-identical.

improvement.justification: v3 preserves all scientific content, evidence, explanations, and reproducibility information, including both appendices. Updating and repositioning the arXiv version/date stamp produces no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
